about_the_game:
Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

DEMO FEATURES

  • Fight as Three Outcast Heroes

Challenge the minions of Sun King Azra with Galandra's fencing prowess and necromantic might, Karl's sturdy knuckles and explosive firepower, or Cider's acrobatic combos and mechanical gadgets. Play solo or have a friend join the rebellion in local or online co-op!

  • Brave the Dangers of Grandery

The first area of the full game, Grandery, is an expansive region where Azra's rise to power shattered the peace between goblins, dwarves, and humans. Carve your path through their enclaves and discover the stunning, hand-crafted environments of a world that changes as your adventure progresses.

  • Reach New Heights of Power

Have a taste of the "Rogue 'em Up" style of Absolum in this Demo: explore multiple paths, face unpredictable encounters, and invoke mighty rituals to empower your attacks. Liberate enshackled magic, train (and trade) with the rebel followers of Mother Uchawi, and gain new powers and abilities after each run.

  • Experience the Beat 'em Up Apex

Dominate Azra's legion with a vast arsenal of moves and combos. Dodge, Deflect, and Clash with your enemies' attacks; and make clever use of items, mounts, and powerful Arcana moves to dispatch the lackeys of the Crimson Order. Rediscover the original feeling of the classic arcade Beat'em Ups, refined by the best artisans of the genre.

name: Absolum Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-540 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 640, 4GB or AMD Radeon HD 5770, 2GB
  • Additional Notes: 720p @ 30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2550K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 TI, 3GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2GB
  • Additional Notes: 1080p @ 60 FPS

short_description: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
